crime: Her roommate's favorite joke was playing dead, with her phone propped up to film whichever prisoner found her.
When {WITCH_NAME} found her "dead" in the lounge, she felt the giggle her roommate was holding in well up in her own chest, and she burst out laughing over the body. The phone caught all of it.
In the dining hall, the roommate replayed the clip for the whole table. "She felt me giggling!" Every face at the table turned to stare.

She had been stared at like that once before. At her grandmother's funeral, she felt her cousin's stifled giggle and laughed out loud, and every mourner turned to look at her. Since then she had worn whatever the nearest girl was feeling on her own face, and no one looked at her twice.

One morning before breakfast, her roommate was rinsing her face at the courtyard fountain. {WITCH_NAME} held her head under the water until she went still, then set her floating face down, just like her drowned-girl prank.

After breakfast, the prisoners crossed the courtyard and saw her floating there. {WITCH_NAME} laughed as though she could feel that giggle again. "Don't give her the reaction," she said, and they walked on.

In the trial court, the prisoners concluded that the prank had gone wrong: the roommate had held her breath too long after they passed. Then a prisoner pointed out her phone, soaked through in her pocket instead of propped up to film anyone. The giggle {WITCH_NAME} claimed to feel had never been there. A dead girl has nothing for anyone to feel.
fields.epitaph: The one time she laughed on her own, it was over the girl she drowned.
fields.epithet: A Face to Match the Room
execution: She was strapped face up inside a glass-lidded coffin, a water spout at her head. The lid shut, and the spout began to run. The water rose around her, then over her upturned face. The spectators leaned over the glass to stare down at her, like the mourners at her grandmother's funeral. She stopped moving with her face still turned up to them beneath the lid.

magic.name: Fellow Feeling
magic.text: She feels what the people around her are feeling, as if it were her own.
